text:
Directional GSEA
Directional GSEA was performed using a ranked list of genes ordered by significance of DE analysis. Here the most significantly upregulated genes are found at one end of the list, while the most significantly down-regulated genes are found at the other.


Code
ranks_before <- lapply(tt, \(x){
    x %>%
        mutate(stat = -log10(PValue) * sign(logFC)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
        with(structure(stat, names = gene_id))
})




Code
tt_dar <- names(tt) %>%
    lapply(\(x){
        tt[[x]] %>%
            dplyr::filter(chr %in% primary_chrs) %>%
            left_join(as_tibble(gene_dar[[x]])[,c("gene_id", "dar")]) %>%
            mutate(darP = pbeta(PValue, pmax(1 - 1.8 * dar, 0.1), 1)) %>%
            dplyr::arrange(darP)
    }) %>%
    set_names(names(tt))




Code
ranks_d <- lapply(tt_dar, \(x){
    x %>%
        mutate(stat = -log10(darP) * sign(logFC)) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
        with(structure(stat, names = gene_id))
})




Code
rank_comparison <- names(ranks_d) %>%
    lapply(\(x){
        # browser()
        before <- enframe(
            ranks_before[[x]],
            name = "gene_id",
            value = "stat"
        ) %>%
            dplyr::arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
            mutate(rank_before = row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::select(gene_id, rank_before)
        after <- enframe(
            ranks_d[[x]],
            name = "gene_id",
            value = "stat"
        ) %>%
            dplyr::arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
            mutate(rank_after = row_number()) %>%
            dplyr::select(gene_id, rank_after)
        left_join(before, after) %>%
            mutate(contrast = x)
    }) %>%
    set_names(names(ranks_d))




Code
rank_comparison %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    ggplot(aes(rank_before, rank_after)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~contrast, ncol = 3)

p_comparison <- names(tt) %>%
    lapply(\(x){
        before <- tt[[x]] %>%
            dplyr::select(gene_id, before_p = PValue)
        after <- tt_dar[[x]] %>%
            dplyr::select(gene_id, after_p = darP)
        left_join(before, after) %>%
            mutate(contrast = x)
    })

p_comparison %>%
    bind_rows() %>%
    ggplot(aes(-log10(before_p), -log10(after_p))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1) +

Hallmark


Code
set.seed(2409)
gsea$d$hm <- lapply(ranks_d, \(x){
    fgseaMultilevel(hm_by_id, x) %>%
        as_tibble() %>%
        dplyr::rename(FDR = padj, Pathway = pathway) %>%
        dplyr::arrange(pval) %>%
        mutate(
            Edge = vapply(leadingEdge, length, numeric(1)),
            Direction = case_when(
                sign(ES) == 1 ~ "Up",
                sign(ES) == -1 ~ "Down",
                sign(ES) == 0 ~ "None"
            ),
            bonf.padj = p.adjust(pval, "bonferroni"),
            Sig = FDR < 0.05,
        )
})

id <- "gsea_d_hm_eofad_wt"
tbl <- gsea$d$hm$eofad_wt %>%
    dplyr::select(Pathway, pval, FDR, Edge, Direction, Sig, leadingEdge) %>%
    mutate(
        Pathway = str_replace_all(Pathway, "_", " "),
        Sig = str_to_title(as.character(Sig)),
        leadingEdge = lapply(leadingEdge, \(x){
            sort(genes$gene_name[genes$gene_id %in% x])
        })
    )

htmltools::browsable(
    tagList(
        tags$caption(glue(
            "{sum(as.logical(tbl$Sig))} of {nrow(tbl)} total pathways ",
            "were classified as significantly enriched. ",
            "This table is interactive where columns can be resized, ",
            "and leading edge genes can be seen by hovering over cells in the 'Edge' column."
        )),
        lb_reactable(
            tbl,
            elementId = id,
            defaultColDef = colDef(
                align = "left",
                minWidth = 80
            ),
            columns = list(
                pval = colDef(cell = react_format("e")),
                FDR = colDef(cell = react_format("e")),
                Pathway = colDef(minWidth = 160),
                Edge = colDef(
                    cell = \(val, ind, col_name){
                        tooltip(
                            val,
                            tbl$leadingEdge[ind]
                        )
                    }
                ),
                leadingEdge = colDef(show = FALSE)
            )
        ),
        tags$button(
            tagList(fontawesome::fa("download"), "Download as CSV"),
            onclick = glue("Reactable.downloadDataCSV('{id}', '{id}.csv')")
        )
    )
)

Network analysis of the significantly enriched pathways. Coloured nodes represent pathways, black nodes represent leading edge genes. The relative size of pathway nodes is determined by -log10(p). Pathway nodes are labelled by their respective name, and in the case of directional GSEA, upregulated pathways are colour blue and downregulated pathways are coloured red.
